origin.mms_origins.floran.name: Floran
origin.mms_origins.floran.description: Plant-folk who live on sunlight behind bark-hard skin. Fire finds them all too easily, and meat is off the table.
origin.mms_origins.fairy.name: Fairy
origin.mms_origins.fairy.description: Tiny winged folk who scale walls and take flight, foraging and mining with uncanny luck. Frail, and no good in a fight.
layer.mms_origins.fairy_wings.name: Wings
mms_origins.gui.choose_wings.title: Choose your Wings
mms_origins.gui.view_wings.title: Your Wings
origin.mms_origins.monarch_butterfly.des: Broad, pointed wings in fiery orange and black.
origin.mms_origins.blue_butterfly.name: Azure Wings
origin.mms_origins.blue_butterfly.descri: Soft, rounded wings in shimmering blue.
origin.mms_origins.cirno_wings.name: Cirno's Wings
origin.mms_origins.cirno_wings.descripti: Crystalline ice-fairy wings of frozen shards.
origin.mms_origins.pixie_wings.name: Fairy Wings
origin.mms_origins.pixie_wings.descripti: Iridescent gossamer wings that catch the light.
origin.mms_origins.slime_wings.name: Slime Wings
origin.mms_origins.slime_wings.descripti: Squishy translucent wings of jellied ooze.
origin.mms_origins.truffle.name: Truffle
origin.mms_origins.truffle.description: Fungal beings immune to poison but frail, fed only on decay. They vent spores to move and strike faster, or to poison their prey.
origin.mms_origins.piglin.name: Piglin
origin.mms_origins.piglin.description: Nether natives who barter gold for treasure and war gear among their own kind. Gold toughens them and fire barely stings, but the overworld sky slowly turns them, and villagers refuse them.
power.mms_origins.bark_skin.name: Bark Skin
power.mms_origins.bark_skin.description: Your hide is woody and thick, worth a measure of armor on its own.
power.mms_origins.photosynthesis.name: Photosynthesis
power.mms_origins.photosynthesis.descrip: Under open sky you tire far more slowly.
power.mms_origins.heat_adaptation.name: Sun-Basked
badge.mms_origins.heat_adaptation.0: Heat builds half as fast and deals half damage.
power.mms_origins.cold_sensitivity.name: Cold-Blighted
badge.mms_origins.cold_sensitivity.0: Cold builds twice as fast and deals double damage.
power.mms_origins.quick_metabolism.name: Quick Metabolism
power.mms_origins.quick_metabolism.descr: Your fast-burning growth leaves you hungry a little sooner than most.
power.mms_origins.verdant_diet.name: Verdant Diet
power.mms_origins.verdant_diet.descripti: You cannot bring yourself to eat meat.
power.mms_origins.diminutive.name: Diminutive
power.mms_origins.diminutive.description: You are very small, and cannot reach as far as others.
power.mms_origins.light_step.name: Light Step
power.mms_origins.light_step.description: You are far too light to set off anything that listens for footsteps.
power.mms_origins.fragile_frame.name: Fragile Frame
power.mms_origins.fragile_frame.descript: Your delicate build leaves you no fighter.
badge.mms_origins.fragile_frame.0: You take 50% more damage from every source, and every blow you land deals only half its damage.
power.mms_origins.wall_scramble.name: Wall Scramble
power.mms_origins.wall_scramble.descript: Press the ability key against a wall to climb it, and again to let go.
power.mms_origins.keen_forager.name: Keen Forager
power.mms_origins.keen_forager.descripti: Your small eyes miss nothing underfoot, turning up more from every stone, foe, and fishing line, and the finest prizes from the chests you plunder.
badge.mms_origins.keen_forager.0: Mine and fell foes as though bearing Fortune and Looting.
badge.mms_origins.keen_forager.1: Your luck runs high, drawing the rarest loot from chests and fishing alike.
power.mms_origins.anxious_heart.name: Anxious Heart
power.mms_origins.anxious_heart.descript: A heavy blow sends your heart racing, dropping you from the air until you calm.
badge.mms_origins.anxious_heart.0: A single hit of 8 damage or more grounds you for 10 seconds.
power.mms_origins.fairy_charm.name: Fairy Charm
power.mms_origins.fairy_charm.descriptio: Villagers are enamoured by your mystique and beauty, and lower their prices for you.
power.mms_origins.fairy_allure.name: Fairy Allure
power.mms_origins.fairy_allure.descripti: The same mystique that charms villagers draws monsters to you.
badge.mms_origins.fairy_allure.0: Hostile mobs seek you from about 20% farther off and prefer you over other prey.
power.mms_origins.fairy_flight.name: Fairy Flight
power.mms_origins.fairy_flight.descripti: While fed, take wing and fly freely; stay aloft too long on an empty stomach and you drop.
badge.mms_origins.fairy_flight.0: Double-tap jump to fly while fed. Flying slowly drains your hunger.
badge.mms_origins.fairy_flight.1: Grow too hungry in the air and you fall from the sky.
power.mms_origins.spore_shift.name: Spore Shift
power.mms_origins.spore_shift.descriptio: You always drift a little faster. Swap between drifting spores for quicker attacks and acrid spores to poison your hits; each spends a reserve that recovers when unused.
badge.mms_origins.spore_shift.0: Press [Primary] to switch between drifting and acrid spores.
badge.mms_origins.spore_shift.1: Press [Secondary] to stow both spores and stop spending the reserve.
power.mms_origins.combat_spores.name: Acrid Spores
power.mms_origins.combat_spores.descript: Acrid spores cling to every strike while these are drawn.
badge.mms_origins.combat_spores.0: Attacks deal extra damage and poison the target, spending the reserve per hit.
power.mms_origins.drift_spores.name: Drifting Spores
power.mms_origins.drift_spores.descripti: A haze of spores keeps you light on your feet, and quickens your strikes while drawn.
badge.mms_origins.drift_spores.0: Always move faster; attacks come quicker while drifting. Sprinting spends the reserve, which refills once you ease off.
power.mms_origins.fungal_constitution.de: Poison and hunger mean nothing to a fungus, but your fruiting body is frail.
badge.mms_origins.fungal_constitution.0: Your maximum health is only 16 (8 hearts).
power.mms_origins.saprophyte_diet.name: Saprophyte
power.mms_origins.saprophyte_diet.descri: You feed only on decay; wholesome food does nothing for you.
badge.mms_origins.saprophyte_diet.0: Eat rotten flesh, spider eyes, poisonous potatoes, and raw meat.
badge.mms_origins.saprophyte_diet.1: Rotten flesh sates you rather than sickening you.
power.mms_origins.nether_born.name: Nether Born
power.mms_origins.nether_born.descriptio: Born of the Nether, you first open your eyes among its fires and always find your way back to them.
badge.mms_origins.nether_born.0: You spawn in the Nether, and respawn there on death.
power.mms_origins.fire_resilience.name: Fire Resilience
power.mms_origins.fire_resilience.descri: Flame and lava are the air you grew up in, and they do little to trouble your hide.
badge.mms_origins.fire_resilience.0: You take 50% less damage from fire and lava.
power.mms_origins.nether_heat_immunity.d: The Nether's furnace air is your birthright, and its heat can never lay you low. Only the Overworld's sun unsettles you.
badge.mms_origins.nether_heat_immunity.0: You are immune to heat stroke in the Nether and after dark, but the Overworld sun leaves you as vulnerable to heat as anyone.
power.mms_origins.nether_forage.name: Nether Forager
power.mms_origins.nether_forage.descript: The Nether's larder is meager, so your kind learned to stomach what grows there.
badge.mms_origins.nether_forage.0: You can eat crimson and warped fungi, mushrooms, and bone meal.
power.mms_origins.shroomlight_snack.name: Glowcap Feast
power.mms_origins.shroomlight_snack.desc: A shroomlight is a rare treat, and its inner fire lingers in you a while after it is eaten.
badge.mms_origins.shroomlight_snack.0: You can eat shroomlights, which leave you glowing for 10 seconds.
power.mms_origins.sun_shy.name: Sun Shy
power.mms_origins.sun_shy.description: The open sky of the overworld is a strange and tiring place, and standing beneath it wears you down.
badge.mms_origins.sun_shy.0: You lose hunger faster while exposed to the open sky.
power.mms_origins.gilded_bearing.name: Gilded Bearing
power.mms_origins.gilded_bearing.descrip: You carry gold as though born to it, and its weight lends your body a real and lasting toughness.
power.mms_origins.kinsmen.name: Kinsmen
power.mms_origins.kinsmen.description: The piglins and their brutes look at you and see one of their own, dealing with you as kin rather than prey.
badge.mms_origins.kinsmen.0: Piglins and piglin brutes are neutral toward you.
badge.mms_origins.kinsmen.1: Piglins barter more valuable loot for you.
power.mms_origins.arms_dealing.name: Arms Dealing
power.mms_origins.arms_dealing.descripti: The brutes guard the bastion armories. Offer gold and a brute may hand over war gear, or simply pocket your payment.
badge.mms_origins.arms_dealing.0: Drop a gold ingot or block by a piglin brute to barter for bastion gear.
badge.mms_origins.arms_dealing.1: A brute keeps your ingot and gives nothing 60% of the time; with a gold block, only 30% of the time.
power.mms_origins.zombification.name: Zombification
power.mms_origins.zombification.descript: The overworld air is poison to your kind; breathe it too long and you begin to turn, mind and body slipping away.
badge.mms_origins.zombification.0: Ten minutes in the overworld turns you, in the Nether or out.
badge.mms_origins.zombification.1: While turned, only raw or rotten flesh feeds you and piglins shun you.
badge.mms_origins.zombification.2: Cured by eating golden food, or by death.
power.mms_origins.quarantine_exile.name: Quarantine Exile
power.mms_origins.quarantine_exile.descr: A turned piglin is no one's kin, and while the sickness holds you your own people want nothing to do with you.
badge.mms_origins.quarantine_exile.0: While turned you cannot barter, and suffer weakness and hunger.
power.mms_origins.beastly.name: Beastly
power.mms_origins.beastly.description: To a villager you are a monster wandered up from the Nether, not a customer, and they will not deal with your sort.
badge.mms_origins.beastly.0: Villagers refuse to trade unless you wear a carved pumpkin.
power.mms_origins.language_barrier.name: Otherworlder
power.mms_origins.language_barrier.descr: You are a stranger to the surface, and its tongue is not yours.
badge.mms_origins.language_barrier.0: Villagers exploit the language barrier to swindle you: every trade costs more.
badge.mms_origins.language_barrier.1: Farmed crops give you far less nourishment.
power.mms_origins.guardian_kinship.name: Guardian Kinship
power.mms_origins.guardian_kinship.descr: Guardians and elder guardians know you for kin and leave you in peace, unless you strike first.
badge.mms_origins.guardian_kinship.0: Guardians and elder guardians stay neutral toward you unless you attack them.
power.mms_origins.cold_blooded.name: Fish Anatomy
power.mms_origins.cold_blooded.descripti: Gills, fins, deep-water eyes, and cold blood: a body built for the sea, not the surface.
badge.mms_origins.cold_blooded.0: Cold cannot harm you at all.
badge.mms_origins.cold_blooded.1: Fire and heat deal 50% more damage to you.
badge.mms_origins.cold_blooded.3: Press [Primary] to dash: sprint-swimming underwater, or grounded in the rain. You cannot jump for a moment after. 5-second cooldown, stacks with Depth Strider.
badge.mms_origins.cold_blooded.4: Press [Secondary] to toggle clear underwater vision.
badge.mms_origins.cold_blooded.5: You breathe underwater and in rain; on land your moisture sustains you.
power.mms_origins.like_water.name: Like Water
power.mms_origins.like_water.description: The sea is yours to move through as freely as others walk on land.
badge.mms_origins.like_water.0: Underwater you do not sink unless you want to.
badge.mms_origins.like_water.1: You break blocks underwater at full speed.
power.mms_origins.seaborn.name: Seaborn
power.mms_origins.seaborn.description: You wake in the open ocean, and can find no rest on dry land.
badge.mms_origins.seaborn.0: You cannot sleep or set your spawn out of the water.
power.mms_origins.seaborn.cant_sleep: You cannot rest out of the water.
power.mms_origins.water_power.name: Water Power
power.mms_origins.water_power.descriptio: The tide answers your blows. Wet, you strike far harder.
badge.mms_origins.water_power.0: Deal much more damage while submerged or in rain.
badge.mms_origins.water_power.1: Deal less damage while hot or in the Nether.
badge.mms_origins.water_power.2: Underwater, your trident deals 1.5x damage, thrown or in melee.
badge.mms_origins.water_power.3.prefix: You are able to craft tridents.
power.mms_origins.wetness.name: Wetness
power.mms_origins.wetness.description: The damp clinging to your skin, and the moisture stored beneath it.
badge.mms_origins.wetness.0: Water, rain, or drinking a water bottle refills both bars.
badge.mms_origins.wetness.1: Damp bar: while it holds, your water powers work on land; empty, they fade until you are wet again.
badge.mms_origins.wetness.2: Moisture bar: while it holds you breathe on land; empty, your air fails. The Nether drains it twice as fast.
badge.mms_origins.wetness.3: A conduit refills the moisture bar and stops it draining.
power.mms_origins.grass_matchup.name: Type Advantage
power.mms_origins.grass_matchup.descript: Green things drink deep. You fall harder on fishmen and water creatures, harder still on a soaked fishman, but wither against fire.
badge.mms_origins.grass_matchup.0: Deal 50% more damage to fishmen and aquatic creatures.
badge.mms_origins.grass_matchup.1: Deal a further 50% more to a wet fishman, when their water power runs strongest.
badge.mms_origins.grass_matchup.2: Deal 50% less damage to blazeborn and fiery creatures.
power.mms_origins.water_matchup.name: Type Advantage
power.mms_origins.water_matchup.descript: Water smothers flame. You fall harder on blazeborn and fiery creatures, but soak against florans.
badge.mms_origins.water_matchup.0: Deal 50% more damage to blazeborn and fiery creatures.
power.mms_origins.fire_matchup.name: Type Advantage
power.mms_origins.fire_matchup.descripti: Fire withers the green. You fall harder on florans, harder still while you burn, but hiss against water, which washes over you all the harder.
badge.mms_origins.fire_matchup.1: Take 50% more damage from aquatic creatures.
badge.mms_origins.fire_matchup.2: Deal a further 50% more to florans while you are on fire.
badge.mms_origins.fire_matchup.3: Deal 50% less damage to fishmen and aquatic creatures.
power.mms_origins.sunlit_vigor.name: Sunlit Vigor
power.mms_origins.sunlit_vigor.descripti: Under open sky your sap runs hot, and your blows land harder.
badge.mms_origins.sunlit_vigor.0: Deal 25% more damage while exposed to the sun.
power.mms_origins.verdant_growth.name: In Tune With Nature
power.mms_origins.verdant_growth.descrip: Life quickens around you, and plants nearby grow faster while you are near.
power.mms_origins.sun_power.name: Sun Power
power.mms_origins.sun_power.description: You store sunlight as life energy. It refills slowly under open sun, allowing you to preserve it for emergencies.
badge.mms_origins.sun_power.0: A reserve of up to seven sections, spent on Sunlit Fury and on raising Grovekeepers.
badge.mms_origins.sun_power.1: It refills slowly under open sky, and a swig of water tops you back up to three sections in a pinch.
power.mms_origins.sunlit_fury.name: Sunlit Fury
power.mms_origins.sunlit_fury.descriptio: Burn your stored sunlight to fight like a thing possessed, your blows landing far harder until the light runs dry.
badge.mms_origins.sunlit_fury.0: Press [Primary] to toggle; while active you deal +3 melee damage, overriding Sunlit Vigor, and steadily burn your Sun Power.
badge.mms_origins.sunlit_fury.1: A full charge lasts about 30 seconds, burning faster the more henchmen you have raised, and the surge switches itself off the moment your Sun Power empties.
power.mms_origins.summon_henchmen.name: Grovekeepers
power.mms_origins.summon_henchmen.descri: Call wood-grown henchmen to fight at your side, sturdier and stronger than common zombies and leaning on your stored sunlight to endure.
badge.mms_origins.summon_henchmen.0: Press [Secondary] to raise one henchman, up to two at once, spending two sections of your Sun Power.
badge.mms_origins.summon_henchmen.1: They never turn on you, and root whatever they strike in slowness for 5 seconds.
badge.mms_origins.summon_henchmen.2: A henchman that falls in battle returns its two sections only after 30 seconds; walk more than 32 blocks from one and it withers away.
power.mms_origins.nature_reclaim.name: Nature's Reclamation
power.mms_origins.nature_reclaim.descrip: Draw on the magic of the dark forest and your stored sunlight to unmake a crafted item back into the materials that built it.
badge.mms_origins.nature_reclaim.0: Standing in a dark forest, hold a crafted item in your off hand and hold [Primary] for 5 seconds to unmake it into its ingredients; a note rings once the channel takes hold.
badge.mms_origins.nature_reclaim.1: Only workable in the dark forest and around noon, and only twice each day, spending two sections of your Sun Power per casting.
badge.mms_origins.nature_reclaim.2: Enchantments are peeled off onto books, one per plain book you carry; any beyond your books are lost.
message.mms_origins.nature_reclaim.not_f: This magic answers only under the dark forest's oaks.
message.mms_origins.nature_reclaim.not_n: The sun must stand overhead for this magic.
message.mms_origins.nature_reclaim.spent: You have spent your reclamations for today.
message.mms_origins.nature_reclaim.no_su: You lack the sun power to reclaim this.
message.mms_origins.nature_reclaim.not_e: You need a full crafted item to reclaim.
message.mms_origins.nature_reclaim.succe: The item unravels into its parts.
